name: Process intensification (rotating packed beds, dividing-wall columns, microreactors)
aliases: Process intensification (rotating packed beds, dividing-wall columns, microreactors)
principle: Intensification combines functions into compact multifunctional devices rather than tuning single unit operations. Examples include reactive distillation, membrane reactors, microreactors and dividing-wall columns.

process_steps.name: Map unit operations and find functions that can be combined
Choose a device: reactive distillation, membrane reactor, microreactor or dividing-wall column
Pilot and phase the change in, starting with lower-risk options
Operate and compare energy and capital against the base case
